title: Perancangan Antarmuka Pengguna Aplikasi Layanan Kesehatan Masyarakat Menggunakan Metode User-Centered Design
abstract: Penelitian ini berfokus pada perancangan ulang antarmuka pengguna (UI/UX) aplikasi pendaftaran pasien rumah sakit daerah menggunakan pendekatan User-Centered Design (UCD). Evaluasi dilakukan menggunakan System Usability Scale (SUS) terhadap 40 pengguna dan menghasilkan skor 84 yang masuk dalam kategori sangat baik.
keywords: UI/UX; User-Centered Design; System Usability Scale; Mobile Health

title: Usability Testing and Heuristic Evaluation on Indonesian FinTech Mobile Applications
abstract: Digital payment adoption relies heavily on intuitive interaction design. This study conducts Nielsen's 10 Heuristic Evaluation and usability testing sessions on three popular Indonesian e-wallet applications, identifying major cognitive friction points in authentication and transfer workflows.
keywords: Usability Testing; Heuristic Evaluation; FinTech; User Experience; Mobile App

title: Evaluasi Kesuksesan Implementasi Sistem Informasi Manajemen Rumah Sakit Menggunakan Model DeLone dan McLean
abstract: Studi empiris ini menguji pengaruh kualitas sistem, kualitas informasi, dan kualitas layanan terhadap kepuasan pengguna serta manfaat bersih organisasi menggunakan model kesuksesan sistem informasi DeLone dan McLean yang dianalisis dengan metode PLS-SEM.
keywords: DeLone and McLean; Sistem Informasi; PLS-SEM; Evaluasi Sistem

title: IT Governance Capability Assessment Using COBIT 2019 Framework in State-Owned Financial Institutions
abstract: Effective alignment between business goals and information technology requires structured governance. This paper evaluates enterprise IT governance maturity levels across APO and BAI domains using the COBIT 2019 framework and formulates strategic improvement roadmaps.
keywords: COBIT 2019; IT Governance; Information Systems Audit; Risk Management

title: Analisis Sentimen Berbasis Aspek pada Ulasan Aplikasi Pemerintahan Menggunakan Fine-Tuning IndoBERT
abstract: Ulasan pengguna di Google Play Store mengandung opini terhadap berbagai aspek layanan aplikasi. Penelitian ini menerapkan fine-tuning model pre-trained IndoBERT untuk mengekstraksi aspek layanan dan mengklasifikasikan polaritas sentimen positif, netral, dan negatif dengan akurasi 90,8%.
keywords: Analisis Sentimen; IndoBERT; Pemrosesan Bahasa Alami; Text Mining

title: Semantic Textual Similarity for Bilingual Academic Abstract Matching Using Multilingual Transformer Models
abstract: Matching scientific documents across Indonesian and English requires cross-lingual semantic understanding. We evaluate pre-trained multilingual Sentence-BERT embeddings combined with cosine similarity to measure topical relevance across bilingual scholarly corpora.
keywords: Multilingual Sentence-BERT; Semantic Similarity; Cosine Similarity; Cross-Lingual NLP

title: Prediksi Churn Pelanggan Layanan Streaming Digital Menggunakan Algoritma LightGBM dan Teknik Resampling SMOTE
abstract: Ketidakseimbangan kelas antara pelanggan yang berhenti berlangganan dan pelanggan aktif menurunkan performa model klasifikasi. Penelitian ini menerapkan SMOTE dan algoritma ensemble LightGBM serta interpretasi fitur SHAP untuk memprediksi potensi churn pelanggan secara akurat.
keywords: Customer Churn; LightGBM; SMOTE; SHAP; Data Mining

title: Retail Customer Segmentation Using RFM Model and Density-Based Spatial Clustering (DBSCAN)
abstract: Understanding purchasing behavior is critical for targeted retail marketing. This study extracts Recency, Frequency, and Monetary (RFM) attributes from transaction logs and compares K-Means with DBSCAN clustering to identify high-value customer segments.
keywords: RFM Analysis; DBSCAN; K-Means; Customer Segmentation; Data Mining

title: Sistem Pendukung Keputusan Penilaian Kinerja Karyawan Terbaik Menggunakan Kombinasi Metode AHP dan TOPSIS
abstract: Penilaian kinerja karyawan membutuhkan pembobotan kriteria yang konsisten dan perangkingan yang objektif. Penelitian ini menggabungkan metode Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) untuk menentukan bobot kriteria dan metode TOPSIS untuk merangking alternatif karyawan terbaik.
keywords: Sistem Pendukung Keputusan; AHP; TOPSIS; Multi-Criteria Decision Making

title: Multi-Criteria Decision Support System for Sustainable Warehouse Location Selection Using Entropy-MOORA
abstract: Selecting optimal logistics distribution centers involves conflicting economic and environmental criteria. This study integrates objective Shannon Entropy weighting with the MOORA method to rank candidate warehouse locations transparently.
keywords: Decision Support System; MOORA; Entropy Weighting; Logistics; MCDM

title: Analisis Penerimaan Pengguna Terhadap E-Learning Kampus Menggunakan Model UTAUT dan Structural Equation Modeling
abstract: Penelitian ini menginvestigasi determinan adopsi sistem pembelajaran daring oleh mahasiswa menggunakan kerangka Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT). Pengolahan data survei dengan PLS-SEM membuktikan pengaruh signifikan performance expectancy terhadap niat penggunaan.
keywords: UTAUT; PLS-SEM; Penerimaan Teknologi; Sistem Informasi Akademik

title: Post-Implementation Evaluation of Cloud ERP Systems in Manufacturing Enterprises
abstract: Transitioning to cloud-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) transforms organizational workflows. This research evaluates critical success factors and user satisfaction in Indonesian manufacturing companies following ERP deployment.
keywords: Enterprise Resource Planning; ERP; Information Systems; Organizational Impact

title: Identifikasi Otomatis Hama dan Penyakit Tanaman Hortikultura Menggunakan Arsitektur YOLOv7 Berbasis Citra Daun
abstract: Deteksi dini penyakit daun sangat penting untuk mencegah gagal panen. Penelitian ini melatih model deteksi objek real-time YOLOv7 pada ribuan citra daun tanaman yang diambil di lapangan dan mencapai nilai mean Average Precision (mAP) sebesar 93,5%.
keywords: Computer Vision; YOLO; Deteksi Penyakit Tanaman; Citra Digital; Deep Learning

title: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks with Spatial Attention for Automated Lung Disease Classification in Chest X-Rays
abstract: Automated analysis of thoracic radiographs assists radiologists in screening pulmonary abnormalities. We propose a ResNet-based CNN architecture enhanced with spatial and channel attention mechanisms to classify pneumonia and tuberculosis from X-ray images.
keywords: Medical Imaging; CNN; Attention Mechanism; Chest X-Ray; Computer Vision

title: Segmentasi Semantik Citra Penginderaan Jauh untuk Pemetaan Tutupan Lahan Perkotaan Menggunakan Arsitektur U-Net
abstract: Pemetaan tutupan lahan dari citra satelit resolusi tinggi membutuhkan akurasi piksel yang presisi. Penelitian ini menerapkan arsitektur encoder-decoder U-Net dengan backbone MobileNet untuk mengklasifikasikan area bangunan, jalan, dan vegetasi hijau.
keywords: Semantic Segmentation; U-Net; Citra Satelit; Remote Sensing; Deep Learning

title: Hybrid 1D-CNN and Bidirectional GRU Network for Short-Term Photovoltaic Wind and Solar Power Forecasting
abstract: Accurate renewable energy forecasting mitigates grid instability. This paper combines 1D Convolutional Neural Networks with Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (BiGRU) to capture spatial-temporal dependencies in historical weather and solar irradiance time-series data.
keywords: Time-Series Forecasting; CNN-BiGRU; Renewable Energy; Deep Learning

title: Perancangan Sistem Pemantauan Kualitas Air Akuakultur Berbasis IoT Menggunakan Transmisi Jarak Jauh LoRa
abstract: Keterbatasan jaringan internet di area tambak pesisir menyulitkan pemantauan parameter air secara kontinu. Penelitian ini mengimplementasikan sensor pH, suhu, dan kekeruhan berbasis mikrokontroler ESP32 dengan modul komunikasi nirkabel LoRa untuk pemantauan real-time.
keywords: Internet of Things; LoRaWAN; ESP32; Kualitas Air; Akuakultur

title: Lightweight MQTT and Edge Computing Architecture for Automated Smart Building Energy Monitoring
abstract: Centralized cloud processing introduces latency in smart building automation. We design a local edge computing gateway using Raspberry Pi and MQTT broker protocol to aggregate smart meter telemetry and optimize HVAC energy consumption.
keywords: Edge Computing; MQTT; Internet of Things; Smart Home; Energy Efficiency

title: Deteksi Anomali Trafik Serangan DDoS pada Lingkungan Software-Defined Network (SDN) Menggunakan Deep Learning
abstract: Serangan Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) dapat melumpuhkan kontroler terpusat pada jaringan SDN. Penelitian ini membangun Intrusion Detection System (IDS) menggunakan kombinasi Autoencoder dan Recurrent Neural Network untuk mendeteksi trafik berbahaya secara akurat.
keywords: Cyber Security; DDoS; Software-Defined Networking; Intrusion Detection System

title: Permissioned Blockchain and Cryptographic Access Control for Secure Healthcare Data Exchange
abstract: Protecting patient privacy during cross-hospital data sharing requires decentralized security mechanisms. This paper implements a Hyperledger Fabric blockchain framework combined with cryptographic proof protocols to secure Electronic Health Records (EHR).
keywords: Blockchain; Electronic Health Record; Data Privacy; Cyber Security; Cryptography

title: Implementasi Design Thinking dan Gamifikasi pada Perancangan Antarmuka Aplikasi Edukasi Interaktif Anak
abstract: Untuk meningkatkan keterlibatan belajar siswa, penelitian ini menerapkan metode Design Thinking yang dipadukan dengan kerangka gamifikasi Octalysis dalam merancang desain interaksi aplikasi pembelajaran mobile, serta diuji menggunakan kognitif walkthrough.
keywords: Design Thinking; Gamifikasi; UI/UX; Desain Interaksi; Aplikasi Edukasi

title: Web Accessibility Evaluation and Inclusive User Interface Redesign Based on WCAG 2.1 Guidelines
abstract: Digital inclusivity requires web platforms to be navigable by users with visual and motor impairments. This research evaluates public service portals against WCAG 2.1 compliance standards and validates inclusive UI components with screen-reader users.
keywords: Web Accessibility; WCAG 2.1; Inclusive Design; User Interface; Usability

title: Prioritisasi Kasus Uji Regresi Otomatis Menggunakan Algoritma Metaheuristik pada Lingkungan Continuous Integration
abstract: Pengujian regresi pada pengembangan perangkat lunak Agile memerlukan efisiensi waktu eksekusi. Penelitian ini mengusulkan optimasi Test Case Prioritization berbasis Algoritma Genetika untuk mendeteksi kesalahan perangkat lunak lebih awal pada pipeline CI/CD.
keywords: Software Engineering; Test Case Prioritization; Algoritma Genetika; Continuous Integration

title: Domain-Driven Decomposition and Containerized Microservices Migration for High-Traffic Web Applications
abstract: Legacy monolithic systems struggle to scale under concurrent user loads. This paper demonstrates a structured migration to Docker and Kubernetes microservices using Domain-Driven Design (DDD), significantly improving throughput and fault isolation.
keywords: Microservices; Domain-Driven Design; Kubernetes; Software Architecture; Cloud Native

title: Peringkasan Dokumen Berita Bahasa Indonesia Secara Ekstraktif Menggunakan Algoritma Graf TextRank dan Word Embedding
abstract: Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem peringkasan teks otomatis (automatic text summarization) pada artikel berita berbahasa Indonesia dengan mengintegrasikan representasi vektor semantik IndoBERT ke dalam matriks ketetanggaan algoritma TextRank, dievaluasi dengan metrik ROUGE.
keywords: Peringkasan Teks; TextRank; IndoBERT; ROUGE; Natural Language Processing

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Dense Passage Retrieval for Bilingual University Information Chatbots
abstract: Large Language Models often hallucinate when answering institution-specific queries. We implement a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline utilizing multilingual vector embeddings to provide grounded question answering over Indonesian and English academic documents.
keywords: Retrieval-Augmented Generation; Question Answering; Large Language Models; Multilingual NLP

title: Klasifikasi Emosi dan Ujaran Kebencian pada Media Sosial Berbahasa Indonesia Menggunakan Arsitektur IndoBERT-BiLSTM
abstract: Teks media sosial di Indonesia memiliki karakteristik tidak baku dan multibahasa. Studi ini menggabungkan kontekstual embedding dari IndoBERT dengan jaringan saraf Bidirectional LSTM untuk mendeteksi ujaran kebencian dan sentimen dengan F1-score 89,7%.
keywords: IndoBERT; BiLSTM; Analisis Sentimen; Klasifikasi Teks; NLP

title: Content-Based Scientific Paper and Reviewer Matching Using Pre-Trained Sentence Transformers
abstract: Automating editorial peer-review assignment requires accurate topical representation of scholarly texts. This paper evaluates Sentence-BERT models and cosine similarity scoring strategies to match submitted manuscripts with reviewer publication histories.
keywords: Sentence-BERT; Reviewer Assignment; Recommender System; Cosine Similarity; Text Mining

title: Sistem Pendukung Keputusan Kelompok Penentuan Prioritas Pembangunan Daerah Menggunakan Metode PROMETHEE II dan Borda
abstract: Pengambilan keputusan yang melibatkan banyak pemangku kepentingan membutuhkan metode agregasi konsensus. Penelitian ini membangun Group Decision Support System (GDSS) dengan metode PROMETHEE II dan fungsi pemungutan suara Borda Count.
keywords: Group Decision Support System; PROMETHEE; Borda Count; SPK Kelompok

title: Fuzzy Multi-Criteria Decision Making Using Fuzzy SAW and VIKOR for Academic Grant Allocation
abstract: Evaluating grant and scholarship proposals involves linguistic uncertainty in reviewer assessments. We propose a hybrid Fuzzy Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) and VIKOR model to generate robust ranking recommendations under uncertain criteria weights.
keywords: Fuzzy SAW; VIKOR; Decision Support System; MCDM; Higher Education

title: Prediksi Risiko Gagal Bayar Pembiayaan Kredit Menggunakan Ensemble Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost)
abstract: Penilaian kelayakan kredit yang akurat dapat meminimalkan kredit macet (non-performing loan) di lembaga keuangan. Penelitian ini menerapkan algoritma ensemble XGBoost dan Random Forest dengan seleksi fitur untuk mengklasifikasikan profil risiko nasabah.
keywords: XGBoost; Random Forest; Risiko Kredit; Machine Learning; Data Mining

title: Explainable Machine Learning with SHAP for Customer Attrition and Credit Scoring Analytics
abstract: Black-box ensemble models often lack transparency required in financial and telecom decision-making. This study integrates SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) with gradient boosted trees to provide interpretable feature attribution in predictive modeling.
keywords: Explainable AI; SHAP; Gradient Boosting; Predictive Analytics; Data Mining

title: Klasifikasi Ekspresi Wajah Mikro Secara Real-Time Menggunakan Arsitektur Vision Transformer (ViT) untuk Analisis Emosi
abstract: Pengenalan ekspresi wajah berbasis deep learning berperan penting dalam interaksi manusia dan komputer. Penelitian ini mengadaptasi model Vision Transformer (ViT) untuk mengenali tujuh kategori emosi wajah mahasiswa pada lingkungan pembelajaran daring.
keywords: Vision Transformer; Pengenalan Ekspresi Wajah; Computer Vision; Affective Computing

title: Real-Time Agricultural Crop Disease Detection on Edge Devices Using Lightweight YOLOv8 Architecture
abstract: Deploying deep learning models for precision agriculture requires computational efficiency. This study optimizes YOLOv8 object detection to identify foliar plant diseases on mobile devices with high inference speed and mAP accuracy.
keywords: YOLOv8; Object Detection; Plant Disease; Computer Vision; Deep Learning

title: Deteksi Situs Web Phishing Berdasarkan Ekstraksi Fitur Leksikal URL dan Struktur DOM Menggunakan Ensemble Learning
abstract: Kejahatan phishing di internet terus meningkat dengan memalsukan halaman login perbankan. Penelitian ini menggabungkan algoritma Random Forest, SVM, dan CatBoost dalam arsitektur Stacking Ensemble untuk mendeteksi URL phishing secara otomatis.
keywords: Phishing Detection; Ensemble Stacking; Cyber Security; Machine Learning; Web Security

title: Anomaly-Based Network Intrusion Detection System Using Deep Autoencoders and LSTM Networks
abstract: Modern cyber attacks bypass traditional signature-based firewalls. We propose a hybrid deep learning Intrusion Detection System (IDS) combining Autoencoder feature compression with LSTM temporal analysis to detect zero-day network intrusions and DDoS traffic.
keywords: Intrusion Detection System; Autoencoder; LSTM; Network Security; Cyber Security

title: Sistem Cerdas Pemantauan dan Kontrol Otomatis Kualitas Air Budidaya Perikanan Berbasis IoT dan Cloud
abstract: Penelitian ini merancang purwarupa sistem Internet of Things (IoT) terintegrasi sensor oksigen terlarut, suhu, dan pH air untuk mengotomatisasi aerator tambak udang serta menyajikan visualisasi data telemetri secara real-time melalui aplikasi web.
keywords: Internet of Things; Smart Aquaculture; Sensor Kualitas Air; Mikrokontroler

title: Performance Evaluation of Containerized Microservices and CI/CD Automation in Cloud-Based Learning Platforms
abstract: Continuous software delivery and elastic scaling are vital for modern educational platforms. This paper benchmarks Kubernetes microservices orchestration and automated regression testing pipelines against legacy monolithic deployments.
keywords: Microservices; CI/CD; Kubernetes; Software Engineering; Performance Benchmarking

title: Peramalan Deret Waktu Beban Konsumsi Listrik dan Energi Surya Menggunakan Jaringan Saraf Tiruan Hibrida CNN-GRU
abstract: Fluktuasi cuaca mempengaruhi stabilitas produksi energi terbarukan panel surya. Penelitian ini membangun model prediksi time-series hibrida 1D-CNN dan Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) untuk meramalkan output daya listrik harian dengan nilai RMSE yang rendah.
keywords: Time-Series Forecasting; CNN-GRU; Energi Surya; Deep Learning; IoT

title: Energy-Efficient Routing and LoRaWAN Network Optimization for Large-Scale Agricultural IoT Sensor Nodes
abstract: Battery lifetime is a primary constraint in wireless sensor networks deployed across rural farmlands. This study optimizes LoRaWAN spreading factors and MQTT payload compression to minimize power consumption in agricultural IoT nodes.
keywords: LoRaWAN; Wireless Sensor Network; Internet of Things; Energy Optimization; MQTT
